in_marathi.name: Gajera
in_marathi.long_meaning: Gajera हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘gaja’, meaning elephant. In Hindu mythology, elephants are revered for their strength, wisdom, and bravery. The name Gajera embodies these qualities, inspiring courage and resilience in the one who bears it.
